note: New route, data side: the words a Chinese question asks for a ranked set of economies with (the ten most populous, the largest economies), each with the reference indicator the set is ranked by. Read by the knowledge group (l5geo.rs, include_str) as a word list: a question one entry's words match asks for that ranking, never for named places. Each word is a template: {n} is a count (digits, or one to ninety-nine in Chinese numerals) and gives how many economies the question asks for; a word without {n} asks for no count. Longer words are tried first. An entry holds words and the reference indicator only: a list of economies, codes or members is refused, since the set is ranked by the program from the fetched rows of the reference indicator (newsroom.ts prepareWorldBank, wb-rank-by.json), never typed here.
